title.en: Unify every Home and Play Today’s Sprint picker
title.zh: 统一主页与 Play 今日速成选择弹窗

purpose.en: Make the Home Learn through Play card open the same complete Today’s Sprint picker as the Home hero and Play page.
purpose.zh: 让主页边玩边学卡片与主页顶部及 Play 页使用同一个完整的今日速成选择弹窗。

en: Open the twelve-language and four-duration picker directly from the Home Today’s Sprint card.
Keep ten minutes selected by default and allow anonymous Beginner Sprint learning.
Preserve the remaining Home game cards and their existing two-step language flow.
Start public Beginner Sprints against the actual Basic course tier used by all twelve seeded courses.
zh: 从主页今日速成卡片直接打开十二种语言与四种时长选择弹窗。
默认选择十分钟，并继续支持匿名初级今日速成学习。
保留主页其他游戏卡片现有的两步语言选择流程。
按十二种预置课程实际使用的 Basic 套餐层级启动公开初级今日速成。

en: Reuse PlayDailySprintPicker for the Home carousel Today’s Sprint tile.
Remove the obsolete Sprint branch from the Home inline language-link builder.
Match public Sprint access by package_tier=basic instead of the human-facing A1 level label.
Add regression coverage for both the shared picker and the public course-access query.
zh: 主页轮播今日速成卡片复用 PlayDailySprintPicker。
移除主页内嵌语言链接生成器中已废弃的今日速成分支。
公开今日速成按 package_tier=basic 匹配，不再错误匹配课程显示等级 A1。
为共享弹窗与公开课程访问查询同时增加回归测试。

en: Run the Daily Sprint contract tests and full repository release gate.
Verify production from both the Home carousel card and Play page card in Chrome.
Confirm all twelve languages, 5/10/15/20 minutes, default ten minutes, and the Start action are visible.
zh: 执行今日速成契约测试与全仓发布门禁。
使用 Chrome 从主页轮播卡片和 Play 页卡片分别复测生产环境。
确认十二种语言、5/10/15/20 分钟、默认十分钟及开始按钮全部可见。

en: Speech scoring still requires genuine learner microphone input and is not simulated by browser automation.
zh: 语音评分仍需要真实学习者麦克风输入，浏览器自动化不会伪造语音。

en: This is a SmartLingo-specific learning-entry repair and does not alter other portfolio sites.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属学习入口修复，不改变其他站点。
